verdict.rationale: Topic clustering and emerging-issue detection are a fair axis for a support platform, but the evidence pack never documents either capability. The closest items are adjacent features: default analytics dashboards with common support metrics, scheduled AI Reports summaries to Slack, Ask AI chat, and AI account fields. None of these cluster conversations by topic or proactively flag emerging product issues before ticket volume spikes, so none earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a support leader, the platform clusters conversations by topic and surfaces emerging product issues before they spike ticket volume
